title: Line Break and Space Cleanup | Trim Lines and Remove Extra Blanks
description: Clean up copied text by trimming spaces at the start and end of each line and collapsing repeated blank lines.
intro:
Text copied from PDFs or web pages often has extra spaces at line ends and repeated blank lines. This tool trims spaces at the start and end of each line, reduces repeated blank lines to one, and removes blank lines at the very start and end.

Spaces between words are left unchanged.
howTo: Paste the text you want to clean into the input box.
The cleaned text appears in the output box.

faq.a: No. Only spaces at the start and end of each line are removed.

faq.q: Can I remove all blank lines?
faq.a: No. A single blank line is kept to separate paragraphs.
